dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Continuous and symmetrical 2D geometric narrowing from the mid-body toward the posterior peduncle, resulting in a streamlined teardrop profile.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light-grey median intensity, representing a transition phase from juvenile grey toward mature white.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-density, diffuse grey mottled clusters localized primarily in the cranial and anterior dorsal regions.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient slope with non-discrete boundaries between the light-grey baseline and slightly darker pigmented patches.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: One distinct dark circular spot on the right lateral side of the head; a smaller dark point mark on the dorsal midline; a dark crescent-shaped feature on the cranial midline.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Crescent-shaped transverse indentation localized on the central dorsal axis of the cranial region.
